scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/backend" "npm run dev -w packages/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.verify:android: node scripts/verify-standalone-android.mjs && node scripts/verify-android-security.mjs && node scripts/verify-direct-router-protocol.mjs && node scripts/verify-apk.mjs && node scripts/verify-open-source-readiness.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w packages/backend && npm run lint -w packages/frontend
